battle.name: 青州之戰
battle.brief: 皇興元年（467），北魏拓跋弘遣長廣王拓跋武南征至鄴，被高敖曹以精騎擊破；同時招降東魏青州刺史張伏保，取齊地置平齊郡，數月後為東魏收復。卡面羅馬標槍不是本戰裝備，此役靠的是環首刀、札甲與弩；標槍在此只作對照：捅盾即折、逼敵棄盾退回的那個原理，正是騎兵長槊與守軍投槊的共同難題。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 青州之戰（467年）是北魏與東魏在山東齊地的一場拉鋸，背景是三方勢力在青齊平原上的重疊。北魏是拓跋氏建立的北方政權，都城平城，皇興元年由獻文帝拓跋弘在位、馮太后臨朝，軍隊仍以鮮卑部落騎兵為骨幹，卻已配上軍鎮、都督將軍與郡縣後方的混合體制，甲騎與漢地鄉兵並行，遠征靠屯田與車隊維持。東魏是北齊的前身，名義上由孝靜帝在鄴即位，實權握在渤海高氏手中，高歡總攬大政，長子高敖曹領大將軍，掌河北精騎，青齊一線則由高氏子弟與漢人刺史分據。齊地本身的行政樞紐是齊州，治所在歷城一帶，另有青州治東陽城。表面看，這是一場北魏主動的攻勢：先以步騎深入鄴下與齊地，再派使招降東魏青州刺史張伏保，以不戰而取齊地；實際上每一方的補給線都伸得很長——北魏自平城南下逾千里，東魏的後方在鄴，南燕已滅而其地人心未定。三方在青齊的角力，決定了誰能把齊地變成永久的前線，誰只能短暫路過。
countriesEn: The Battle of Qingzhou (467) was a see-saw struggle between Northern Wei and Eastern Wei over the Qi region of Shandong, fought out in a landscape where three powers overlapped on the same plain of Qing and Qi. Northern Wei was the northern state founded by the Tuoba clan, with its capital at Pingcheng; in the first year of Huangxing it was ruled by Emperor Xianwen, Tuoba Hong, with the empress dowager Feng still holding the regency. Its army still had the fresh cavalry of the Xianbei tribal levy at its core, but it had been fitted out with a mixed system of military garrisons, commandants-general and county rear areas, armoured riders and Han Chinese militia fighting side by side, and its distant campaigns were sustained by garrison farms and wagon trains. Eastern Wei was the predecessor of Northern Qi: in name the Xiaojing emperor sat on the throne at Ye, but real power lay with the Gao family of Bohai, for Gao Huan took charge of the government, his eldest son Gao Aochao held the post of general-in-chief with the fine horse of Hebei, and the Qing-Qi line was held by Gao kinsmen and Han Chinese governors in combination. The administrative hinge of the region was the prefecture of Qi, whose seat lay around Licheng, with Qingzhou itself seated at Dongyang. On the surface this was a Northern Wei offensive: first to drive foot and horse down to the ground below Ye and into Qi, then to send emissaries and win over Zhang Fubao, the Eastern Wei governor of Qingzhou, taking Qi without a battle. In reality every side's supply line was stretched thin: Northern Wei lay more than a thousand li south of Pingcheng, the Eastern Wei rear area was Ye, and in the wake of the fall of Southern Yan the people of the land were unsettled. The struggle over Qing and Qi settled who would turn that ground into a permanent front and who could only pass through it for a season.
people: 此役能落到具體人頭上的並不多，但每一位都關係到齊地的去留。北魏方面，獻文帝拓跋弘在皇興元年（467）即位後仍由馮太后臨朝主持，自己握著最高調兵的權；真正在東線跑的是他的弟弟長廣王拓跋武，領大軍南下至鄴，同行有北海王拓跋詳等宗室。拓跋武在鄴下的一場慘敗，幾乎把北魏這次東征的算盤打散，連軍資都棄在敵境。齊地士人劉劭在皇興年間應召北上，參與官品與律令的修訂，這條人事線在幾年後長成了孝文帝的漢化。東魏這邊，渤海王高歡早已代魏秉政，卻把河北的兵事交給長子高敖曹；高敖曹以驍勇著稱，是東魏在河北最硬的刀，也是他在鄴下把魏軍打崩的直接原因。高澄此時以司徒身份在鄴中理政，張伏保則是青齊一線的關鍵人物：正是他把刺史的印與城邑拱手交給北魏，事後被安置為平齊郡守，但郡未守成，隨北魏軍退往北方。東魏收復平齊郡的行動，一般繫於高歡麾下的宿將侯景率輕騎長驅而至；另有齊地豪右與流民在易姓之際各尋出路，北上的隨魏軍南去，留守的趁亂擴張私兵。
peopleEn: Few people in this war are named in the record, but each of them bears on the fate of Qi. On the Northern Wei side Emperor Xianwen, Tuoba Hong, was on the throne in the first year of Huangxing (467) with the empress dowager Feng still presiding over affairs, although the supreme right to move the armies remained his; the man actually operating on the eastern front was his brother, Prince Changguang Tuoba Wu, who led a great army south as far as Ye, accompanied by other princes of the clan such as Prince Beihai Tuoba Xiang. The crushing defeat Tuoba Wu suffered below Ye scattered the whole plan of the Northern Wei expedition and left the baggage abandoned in enemy territory. Scholar Liu Shao of the Qi region was summoned north in the Huangxing years and took part in the revision of official ranks and statutes, and that line of personnel later grew into the Sinicisation of Emperor Xiaowen. On the Eastern Wei side the Bohai prince Gao Huan had long governed in place of the emperor, yet he left the fighting in Hebei to his eldest son Gao Aochao, a man famed for his daring and the hardest blade Eastern Wei had in Hebei; it was he who broke the Wei army below Ye. Gao Cheng was managing government at Ye in his capacity as director of the household affairs, while Zhang Fubao was the decisive figure on the Qing-Qi line: it was he who handed over the governor's seal and the towns of his command to Northern Wei, and afterwards was installed as governor of the Pingqi commandery, though the commandery was never held, and he withdrew north with the Wei troops. The recovery of the Pingqi commandery is generally credited to Gao Huan's veteran general Hou Jing, who drove in with light horse; other gentry of the Qi region and displaced households each found their own road at the change of masters, some going south with the Wei army, others staying behind and enlarging their private bands in the disorder.
kits: 本戰在青齊與鄴下兩個方向上動用的東西，與卡面那支羅馬標槍沒有直接關係：魏晉南北朝的中國軍隊並不使用羅馬式重投射槍，標槍在此只能當作對照件。實際裝備方面，雙方步兵是漢式鐵札甲配木胎漆皮大盾，兜鍪下露面，握環首直刃刀與長柄矛；騎兵用長槊、弓矢與披甲馬，東魏的精騎人馬皆備重甲，北魏的甲騎同樣以衝擊為主。投射火力靠弩與弓，張弩與蹶張弩是守城與野戰的骨幹，攻城時還有雲梯、撞車、穴地與塹壕，火箭與火炬用於焚燒門樓與遮蔽物，漢末曹魏已能製造的石砲在北方也見於記載。羅馬標槍真正能對照的，是它背後的一條工程學道理：半米長、中空輕桿配重鐵鏢，捅穿木盾後即折斷，敵兵被釘在盾上只能帶半截槍退回，攻方不必花力氣把盾連人拖下。同一難題在467年同樣擺在兩邊面前：騎兵以長槊互刺，槊桿刺入鎧甲或盾牌後常難以拔出，命中者連人帶馬失衡墜地，攻方還可能被倒馬壓住槊桿；守城一方從女牆向下投擲短矛與標槍，刺穿遮蔽的槍身折斷後，遮蔽的人就得抱著半截槍退回。差別在於羅馬用折斷換取輕省，中國用鐵鏃加重，靠槊的長度與雙手握持換取穿透與推力。
kitsEn: What was actually used on the two fronts at Qing and Qi has nothing directly to do with the Roman pilum on the card: Chinese armies of the Wei, Jin, Northern and Southern dynasties did not use a heavy Roman-style throwing javelin, and the pilum can only serve here as a reference piece. On equipment, the infantry of both sides wore Han-style iron lamellar armour over wooden shields faced with lacquer, kept their faces clear under a helmet, and carried a ring-pommel straight-blade sword and a long-handled spear; the cavalry used the long sa spear, the bow and a caparisoned horse, with Eastern Wei's fine horse fully armoured in man and beast and Northern Wei's armoured riders built for the charge in the same way. Missiles came from the bow and the crossbow, with the tensioned crossbow and the strong-armed draw crossbow forming the backbone of both siege and field work; for assaults there were scaling ladders, battering rams, mining and trenching, while fire-arrows and torches were used against gate towers and awnings, and the stone-throwers that Cao Wei could already build in the late Han appear in northern accounts as well. What the Roman pilum really allows one to compare is the engineering principle behind it: half a metre of light hollow shaft with a heavy iron shank, which snaps off after passing through a wooden shield, so that the man pinned to his shield has to withdraw carrying half a spear, and the attacker does not have to drag shield and man down together. The same problem stood in front of both sides in 467. Horsemen thrust at each other with long sa; the shaft, once it had entered armour or shield, was often hard to pull free, so the man struck lost his balance and went down with his horse, and the attacker could be pinned under a falling horse and his own shaft. On the defending side, short spears and javelins were thrown down from the parapet, and once the shaft broke after passing through the cover, the man behind that cover had to fall back clutching half a spear. The difference lay in the solution: Rome bought lightness by breaking the shaft, while China added weight to the iron head and used the length of the sa plus a two-handed grip to buy penetration and push.
tactics: 兩場戰鬥的打法幾乎相反，值得分開寫。鄴下那一場是騎兵對騎兵的野戰：北魏拓跋武自北而南下，直抵東魏都城郊野，東魏高敖曹不急於守城，而是以精騎在城南迎戰，選擇在開闊的河北平原上展開兵力，一次衝鋒就把遠道而來的魏軍打散。魏軍失敗的關鍵不在戰意，而在接戰前的準備：遠征千里，人馬疲憊，陣形拉得過長，後隊與前隊脫節，敵騎一插即斷。齊地那一段則是另一種打法：魏軍沒有硬攻歷城、青州城，而是先派使招撫，說動青州刺史張伏保以城邑與部眾歸降，一紙平齊郡的郡名便把政治控制變成行政控制；其後東魏出兵收復時，局面又翻回去，說明「以招降取城」這種辦法在內地能奏效，靠的是對方內部對高氏的不滿，一旦東魏的騎兵重新上馬，郡兵便守不住沒有塹壕、沒有援軍的孤城。青齊一帶當時黃河主河道仍在河北北流，輸糧靠濟水與汶泗水系，濟南歷城是水陸轉運的樞紐；山地丘陵夾在平原之間，牛車隊一日難以推行百里，這也是北魏孤軍深入最吃不消的部分。兵制上，北魏沿軍鎮與都督將軍的舊制分兵，東魏則倚州郡募兵與高氏部曲，兩邊都靠旗鼓金鼓與驛騎傳令，戰場上最先失效的往往不是刀，是消息。
tacticsEn: The two engagements were fought in almost opposite ways, and they are worth separating. The action below Ye was a cavalry battle in the open: Tuoba Wu of Northern Wei came down from the north and reached the fields outside the Eastern Wei capital, and Gao Aochao did not hurry to defend the city but met him with his fine horse to the south of it, choosing to deploy on the open plain of Hebei, where a single charge broke the Wei army that had come so far. What defeated the Wei was not a lack of will but the state of the troops before contact: after a thousand li of marching the men and horses were worn out, the line had been stretched too long, rear and forward had come apart, and once the enemy horse was in among them the line simply broke. The Qi part was fought in another manner entirely. The Wei did not throw themselves at the walls of Licheng or the city of Qingzhou; they sent emissaries first, persuaded Zhang Fubao, the governor of Qingzhou, to bring his towns and people over, and a single administrative name, the commandery of Pingqi, turned political control into administrative control. When Eastern Wei came to recover it, the situation turned back again, which shows that the method of taking a town by inducement could work inland only because of the resentment inside the other side towards the Gao house; once Eastern Wei's horse were mounted again, the commandery troops could not hold a lone city with no ditch and no relief. In the Qing and Qi region the main channel of the Yellow River still ran north through Hebei, so grain moved by the Jishui and the Wensishui systems, with Licheng south of the Ji serving as the pivot of water-and-land transshipment; hills and low ridges stand between the plains, and an ox-wagon train could hardly cover a hundred li in a day, which was the hardest thing for the isolated Northern Wei force to endure. On organisation, Northern Wei kept the old system of military towns and commandants-general, while Eastern Wei leaned on recruited county troops and the Gao private bands; both sides ran the field on drums, gongs, flags and mounted couriers, and what usually failed first on the battlefield was not the sword but the news.
data: 關於這場戰爭，可用的數字不多，能站住的只有幾條。兵員上，《資治通鑑》記東魏大將軍高敖曹以精騎五萬迎戰北魏軍於鄴下，這個「五萬」是史家的約數，反映的是河北一次會戰可投入上萬騎兵的量級，而不是實點名冊；北魏遠征軍的規模，史料沒有留下同樣明確的數字，只說是一路南伐直抵鄴下。行政上有一個可以核對的年份與名目：皇興元年（467）北魏置平齊郡，把齊地從東魏手中接過來，但這個郡在實際控制上只維持數月，隨即為東魏收復，《魏書·地形志》仍把平齊郡列在青州之下，說明它留的是名目，不是實土。時間上，這一輪戰事從467年年初打到年底，齊地拉鋸大半年；同年北魏攻鄴失利，卻在同一時間內拿下一片齊地，等於用一次敗仗換來一次招降。距離是這場戰爭最要命的數字：北魏都城平城（今山西大同）到東魏都城鄴（今河北臨漳）約六百公里，到齊州歷城、青州一線超過一千公里；鄴到歷城約四百公里，歷城到廣固約一百公里。北魏要打齊地，一支萬騎規模的軍隊每天光人馬口糧就要二十幾噸，粟、麥之外還要沿途徵草給馬吃，千里運糧要數千輛牛車輪流，這個量級決定了任何遠征都不可能長期留在敵後。損失方面，鄴下魏軍的具體死傷數字史無明文，只留下軍資委棄、拓跋武僅以身免這類描述，所以只能說慘重，不能給出數目。
dataEn: Few figures survive for this war, and only a few of them will bear weight. On strength, the Zizhi Tongjian records that the Eastern Wei general-in-chief Gao Aochao met the Northern Wei army below Ye with five tens of thousands of fine horse; that figure of fifty thousand is a chronicler's round number, and it shows the scale of horse that a single battle in Hebei could put in the field, not an actual roll of names. The size of the Northern Wei expedition is not given with the same clarity, only that it marched south and reached the ground below Ye. On the administrative side there is one date and one name that can be checked: in the first year of Huangxing (467) Northern Wei established the commandery of Pingqi, taking the Qi country over from Eastern Wei, yet the commandery was held in fact for only a few months before Eastern Wei recovered it, and the Wei shu topography treatise still lists Pingqi under Qingzhou, which shows that a name was preserved, not real territory. In time, the round of fighting ran from the beginning of 467 to the end of the year, with the Qi country see-sawing for the better part of six months; in the same year Northern Wei was beaten below Ye yet at the same moment took a stretch of the Qi country, so to speak it bought an inducement with a defeat. Distance is the most consequential number in this war: from the Northern Wei capital of Pingcheng, in present-day Datong in Shanxi, to the Eastern Wei capital of Ye, in present-day Linzhang in Hebei, is about six hundred kilometres, and to the line of Licheng in Qi prefecture and of Qingzhou it is over a thousand; from Ye to Licheng is about four hundred kilometres, and from Licheng to Guanggu about a hundred. For Northern Wei to strike at Qi, a horse force of ten thousand would need more than twenty tonnes of grain every day for men and animals alone, on top of oats and wheat, and would have to gather fodder along the road for the horses; moving grain a thousand li required thousands of ox wagons in rotation, and at that scale no distant expedition could stay long in the enemy's rear. On losses, no clear figure for the Wei dead and wounded below Ye has been preserved, only descriptions such as the baggage being thrown away and Tuoba Wu escaping with his life, so the defeat can be called severe but cannot be given a number.
cause: 起因有三層。最外層是北魏統一北方的最後一步：拓跋氏先後滅掉後燕、赫連勃勃的夏與吐谷渾，山西、河北大部已在手，剩下的對手只剩高歡把持的東魏，以及齊地一帶的豪右勢力，北方需要的是把山東這一段邊界拉直，讓後方與前線接上。第二層是東魏自己的裂痕：高歡以漢人出身替東魏實控朝政，鮮卑貴族與漢人官僚彼此不服，青齊一線的刺史對高氏的徵斂與強徵並無好感，這給了北魏招撫的縫隙——張伏保的降不是北魏打進去的，是北魏說下來的。第三層是雙方在河北到山東這條線上互相試探：北魏出兵東向，路線是南下至鄴、再取齊地；東魏則靠騎兵在平原上反擊，任何一方丟掉鄴或齊地，另一方都會立刻貼上來。於是出現了467年這種看似矛盾的組合：北魏在鄴下打了敗仗，卻在青州得手；東魏在鄴下贏得很漂亮，卻在齊地丟了城。真正點火的是齊地本身的政治真空：自前燕末年以來，慕容氏的南燕在山東起滅一波三折，397年慕容超再取廣固、410年為劉裕所破，豪右與流民在改朝換代之間各自屯聚，誰來給他們一個名義，誰就能把這片地變成自己的前沿。
causeEn: The causes run in three layers. The outermost is the last step of Northern Wei's unification of the north: the Tuoba had already destroyed Later Yan, the Xia of Helian Bobo and the Tuyuhun, and held most of Shanxi and Hebei; what remained against them was only Eastern Wei under Gao Huan and the power of the local gentry around the Qi country. What the north needed was to straighten out the frontier in Shandong so that the rear areas and the forward line would join up. The second layer is a crack inside Eastern Wei itself: Gao Huan, a man of Han Chinese origin, ran the state in place of the Eastern Wei emperor, the Xianbei nobles and the Han Chinese officials did not get along with each other, and the governors on the Qing-Qi line had no affection for the Gao family's levies and exactions. That was the seam the Northern Wei emissaries found: Zhang Fubao's surrender was not beaten into him, it was talked out of him. The third layer is the mutual testing along the Hebei-to-Shandong line: when Northern Wei marched east its route was south to Ye and then on to Qi, while Eastern Wei answered with cavalry on the plains, and whoever lost Ye or the Qi country would immediately have the other on top of him. Hence the seemingly contradictory combination of 467: Northern Wei lost a battle below Ye yet gained ground at Qingzhou, and Eastern Wei won splendidly below Ye yet lost a city in Qi. What truly lit the fuse was the political vacuum in the Qi country itself. Since the late Former Yan, the rise and fall of the Southern Yan under the Murong clan in Shandong had run through three turns: the Southern Yan took Guanggu again in 397 under Murong Chao and was destroyed by Liu Yu in 410, and in the shifts of dynasty that followed the gentry and the displaced clustered with their own followings. Whoever gave them a name to serve under could turn this ground into their own forward position.
impact: 這一役的直接果實不大，深遠影響卻不少。齊地在北魏手上只熱了幾個月，北魏沒有把它變成州郡的實土，反而在《魏書·地形志》留下一個幾乎空殼的平齊郡；真正拿下齊地要等七年之後，太武帝拓跋燾在皇興三年（474）遣軍攻鄴，把鄴與河北北部一併取下，並徙齊地人口十餘萬實濟北，青齊才真正變成北魏的腹地。這次勝負還補上了一課：北魏的騎兵能打贏平原上的會戰，卻補不上千里外征的糧秣與指揮，至於對遠方羈縻之地的經營，此時仍只見於文書，未見成效。就制度而言，467年之後北魏的漢化線索更清楚了：同年九月生於平城的拓跋宏，日後把都城遷到洛陽、行均田與三長制；齊地士人劉劭這類人北上入仕，是那條人事通道的第一批。對東魏高氏來說，這一仗等於被提醒了兩件事：齊地不是天險，鄴也不是萬能，騎兵再強也守不住河北平原縱深被北方滲透的風險，於是高氏在往後十多年裡加速把重心移向河南與河北的屯田與戶口。對齊地百姓而言，467年又一次換旗，兵糧與徭役年年重派，這些才是史書不記而人人經歷的部分。
impactEn: The direct fruits of this war were slight, but its deeper effects were not. The Qi country grew warm in Northern Wei's hands for only a few months, and Wei did not turn it into the solid territory of a prefecture or commandery; it left behind instead a nearly hollow shell, the commandery of Pingqi, in the Wei shu topography treatise. Qi was genuinely taken seven years later, when the Taiwu emperor Tuoba Tao sent an army against Ye in the third year of Huangxing (474), took Ye and northern Hebei together, and moved more than a hundred thousand people of the Qi country to settle north of the Ji; only then did Qing and Qi become real hinterland for Northern Wei. This fight also supplied a lesson: Northern Wei's cavalry could win a battle on the plains, but it could not make up for the grain and the command needed for a campaign a thousand li from home, and the administration of distant dependent states remained, at this point, a matter of documents rather than results. On institutions, the threads of Northern Wei's Sinicisation become plainer after 467. Tuoba Hong, born at Pingcheng in the ninth month of the same year, would later move the capital to Luoyang and institute the equal-field system and the three-chief system; men such as the Qi scholar Liu Shao, who went north to serve, were the first through that channel of personnel. For the Gao house of Eastern Wei the war was a warning on two counts: the Qi country was no natural barrier, and Ye was no guarantee, and however strong the horse, they could not shield the open depth of the Hebei plain against penetration from the north. The Gao therefore speeded the shift of their weight over the following decade into stock-farming and household registration in Henan and Hebei. For the people of the Qi country, 467 was another change of flag, with war levies and labour service levied year upon year, and that was the part of it the histories do not record but everyone lived through.
result: 結果是兩種收場疊在一起。野戰上，467年鄴下那一仗北魏輸得很徹底：高敖曹以精騎大破拓跋武，魏軍潰散，軍資盡棄，主將僅以身免，北魏這次東征的銳氣與補給一併丟在鄴郊。齊地那段，北魏卻用招降的方式得手：青州刺史張伏保以城邑部眾降魏，魏廷據此置平齊郡，齊地在形式上歸入北魏版圖；但東魏很快回兵收復，郡兵隨魏軍退往北方，平齊郡只剩下《魏書·地形志》裡的一行名目，齊地實際上仍在高氏手中。到年終，雙方邊界大致回到原狀：北魏退回平城與河北北部，東魏保住鄴與青齊，青齊一線的士人分作兩路，北上的隨魏軍離鄉，留守的等到474年魏軍破鄴才再換一次旗幟。這場戰爭在戰術上沒有多少可以傳世的名局，它真正的收穫是給北魏記下一筆帳：從平城到鄴、從鄴到齊地，路線是對的，騎兵是能贏的，但糧秣、指揮與據點三者缺一不可；這筆帳，直到拓跋燾北伐時才算還清。對青齊而言，467年只是北魏插進來的一面旗，兩年之後它就會換成另一面。
resultEn: The outcome combines two different endings. In the open field, Northern Wei lost the day below Ye in 467 completely: Gao Aochao broke Tuoba Wu with his fine horse, the Wei army dissolved, the baggage was thrown away and the commander escaped with his life, and the drive and the supplies of the expedition were both left in the fields below Ye. In the Qi country, however, Northern Wei gained its point by inducement. The governor of Qingzhou, Zhang Fubao, brought his towns and people over to Wei, the court on that basis established the commandery of Pingqi, and in form the Qi country passed into the Wei map; but Eastern Wei soon marched to recover it, the commandery troops withdrew north with the Wei army, and the commandery of Pingqi was left with nothing but a line in the Wei shu topography treatise, while the Qi country in fact stayed in Gao hands. By the end of the year the frontier stood roughly where it had stood: Northern Wei had fallen back to Pingcheng and northern Hebei, Eastern Wei had kept Ye and the Qing and Qi country, and the men of letters of that region had split, some going north with the Wei troops and others waiting until 474, when the Wei army took Ye, to change their flag once more. Tactically this war left no set-piece worth handing down; its real yield was a line in Northern Wei's ledger. The road from Pingcheng to Ye, and from Ye to the Qi country, was the right road, and the horse could win; but grain, command and fortified ground were all indispensable. That ledger was not settled until Tuoba Tao's northern campaigns. For Qing and Qi, 467 was only a flag that Northern Wei had planted, and within two years it would be flying a different colour.
